name: Boggard Pit (5-6)
source: Pathfinder Society Scenario #1-20: The Lost Legend
description: A net with soil and aquatic plants on it covers a 10-foot pit dug into the bottom of a body of water.
reset: Others can fall into the pit, but the net entangles only the first creature to trigger the trap. The net must be reset manually.

generalAbilities.name: Pitfall
generalAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature walks on the net.

Effect The triggering creature falls into a spiked pit and submerges, with the net collapsing to entangle the creature. Spikes in the pit deal 2d10 Piercing Damage damage. The net imposes a -10-foot penalty to the creature's speed. A creature must succeed at two DC 18 checks to Escape from the net a critical success to Escape frees them immediately. A creature that can't breathe underwater may begin drowning. Any round the creature struggles to escape the net, the creature uses 2 rounds of air.
